content_units: 90-Minute Family Road-Trip Mix

A kid-friendly 18-song flow for two adults and one 8-year-old, built around upbeat pop, clean hip-hop, 3 singalong classics, and 3 calmer transition tracks. Total runtime should land close to   90 minutes   depending on version/album edits.
18-Track Playlist Sequence
Artist   Song   Energy   Where it fits in the playlist
1   Justin Timberlake   Can't Stop the Feeling!   High   Start-of-drive mood lift; easy for everyone to jump into
2   Katy Perry   Firework   High   Early burst of energy once the car is moving
3   Black Eyed Peas   I Gotta Feeling   High     Singalong classic 1  ; big chorus for the whole car
4   Owl City & Carly Rae Jepsen   Good Time   Medium-High   Keeps the momentum fun without getting too loud too fast
5   Macklemore & Ryan Lewis   Can't Hold Us   High   Clean, fast-paced stretch for highway energy
6   American Authors   Best Day of My Life   High   Family-friendly shout-along section
7   Pharrell Williams   Happy   Medium-High   Bright reset before the first transition
8   Jason Mraz   I'm Yours   Low-Medium     Calmer transition 1  ; windows-down, relaxed cruising
9   Bruno Mars   Treasure   Medium   Smooth groove that rebuilds energy gently
10   Walk the Moon   Shut Up and Dance   High   Mid-playlist peak; strong group singalong
11   Natasha Bedingfield   Unwritten   Medium-High     Singalong classic 2  ; uplifting and easy to belt out
12   OneRepublic   Good Life   Medium   Scenic-road section; positive but not too intense
13   Flo Rida   Good Feeling   High   Second wind when attention starts to dip
14   Post Malone & Swae Lee   Sunflower   Low-Medium     Calmer transition 2  ; familiar and mellow for all ages
15   Taylor Swift   Shake It Off   High   Re-energizer before the final stretch
16   Maroon 5   Sugar   Medium-High   Keeps the mood playful and light
17   Journey   Don't Stop Believin'   Medium-High     Singalong classic 3  ; big endgame anthem
18   Andy Grammer   Good To Be Alive (Hallelujah)   Medium     Calmer transition 3 / end-credits closer  ; happy landing song
Why This Flow Works
-   Front third:   quick hooks and recognizable pop to get everyone engaged fast.
-   Middle third:   one calm dip around tracks 8 and 14 so the playlist doesn’t feel exhausting.
-   Final third:   returns to high-energy, then lands with a feel-good closer instead of ending too abruptly.
-   Kid-safe fit:   songs selected for broadly clean, radio-friendly listening from the 2000–2020 range.
Quick Swap Options
If you want to rotate songs without changing the structure, swap in any of these:
- Replace   Can't Hold Us   with   The Show Goes On – Lupe Fiasco   for cleaner pop-rap energy.
- Replace   Sugar   with   Cake by the Ocean (clean version) – DNCE   if you want more bounce.
- Replace   I'm Yours   with   Count on Me – Bruno Mars   for a softer family singalong.
